dependencies: SV2-MIG-03: the cutover reads the session catalog that the legacy backfill fills; SV2-MIG-01 and SV2-MIG-02 consumer inventory and expiring aliases stay in hooks.memory.compatibility and hooks.memory.api.records
evidence_class: mocked: questions reconstructed from repository history over the sanitized session tools fixture, served by temporary SQLite catalogs and object stores; no live transcript, hosted catalog or deployed consumer was used

fixture_inputs.capture: a new turn appended to the lock session while the consumer route is switched and rolled back
fixture_inputs.grants: the fixture grant over both projects, and a narrow grant over the kernel project only
fixture_inputs.questions: catalog lock incident and empty kernel feed, each with a hand checked expected source range
fixture_inputs.unexpandable: the same catalog served with an empty object store, so search answers and expansion is refused

interfaces: hooks.memory.cutover.shadow replays fixed questions through session_search and expands every hit with session_records under the same grant; an expected range counts as recalled only when each of its sequences was expanded
ConsumerRoutes.qualify stores the shadow proof bound to consumer and grant under an operation id derived from the inputs and the outcome
ConsumerRoutes.switch moves a consumer between local.v1 and session.v1 by compare and set on the route revision and only with an accepted proof for that consumer and grant
ConsumerRoutes.rollback restores the previous route as a new revision without touching capture, the catalog or stored proofs
ConsumerRoutes.call dispatches to the routed endpoint, checks the request protocol major against the endpoint version and keeps alias expiry from hooks.memory.api.records
metrics: shadow_search_source_recall is recalled expected ranges over expected ranges for the fixture questions; case A observed 1.0 over two questions and two ranges, case B observed 0.0 for the unexpandable consumer

outcomes.accepted: shadow proofs stored by ConsumerRoutes.qualify with state accepted
outcomes.committed: route revisions in the fixture route store written by switch and rollback
outcomes.externally_verified: none; no deployed consumer was switched and no live catalog was replayed
outcomes.observed: case outputs in the a, b and c result files from CI on the tested commit

remaining_limitations: The questions are reconstructed from repository history over the sanitized session tools fixture; replaying live historical sessions needs read access to the hosted catalog.
No consumer outside agentihooks routes through ConsumerRoutes yet.
Route changes are authorized by the caller grant; the route store has no separate operator role.
rollback_rehearsal: case C switched the consumer, restarted the route store, captured a new turn, rolled back to local.v1 at revision 2, replayed the rollback with the same result, kept the shadow proof and refused the stale switch
